# FlowZen

FlowZen is an all-in-one HRMS platform that helps companies manage people operations and daily work in a single workspace.

## What FlowZen does

- All-in-one HRMS: HR records, roles, attendance, and employee management
- Recruitment: job postings, candidate pipeline, ATS scoring, interviews, and offer letters
- Finance: invoicing, salary slips, and expense workflows
- Kanban boards with real-time collaboration
- IT helpdesk ticketing
- Team chat and document letters with e-signatures

## Suitable for

Small to mid-sized companies that want HR, recruitment, finance, and project work unified in one tool.
